provisional: No live layout response has been found: the game does not cache them in its save directory. Evidence is the field values themselves and the store items the game records as seen (StoreNotificationsData.sav in the save directory); that list is kept per machine, not per account, so it says what the store showed, not what was personal. The rest is judgment.
